description: This Java class defines a configuration object for HTTP settings in the Eclipse Ditto project, including hostname, port, and shutdown timeout, with factory methods and override implementations.

classes.name: DefaultHttpConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing HttpConfig and WithConfigPath, representing HTTP configuration settings with factory method and overridden methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method creating an instance of DefaultHttpConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname for the HTTP server.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the HTTP server.

methods.name: getCoordinatedShutdownTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration of the coordinated shutdown timeout.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the fixed config path string, 'http'.
